title: Reliable High-Performance Programmable Voltage Regulator with 0.55A Sink Current for Cryo-Cooler Electronics in 0.18μm HV-CMOS Technology
problem: Cryo-cooler electronics require programmable voltage regulators with high current-sinking capability and wide input voltage range (10V-60V) while maintaining tight voltage regulation for sensitive downstream circuits.
motivation: Cryogenic cooling systems used in quantum computing and other advanced applications require robust voltage regulators that work across extreme input voltage ranges with high current capability.
method: Novel programmable topology voltage regulator in 0.18μm HV-CMOS technology. Output voltage programmable from 5V to 55V with 550mA sink current capability. Designed as low-side supply for HV gate driver circuits.
key_novelty: Programmable regulator with 550mA sink current capability in small die area (0.09mm²) with excellent line/load regulation in HV CMOS process.
contributions: Peak voltage variation: 0.42mV during current pulses
Robustness validated through Monte Carlo analysis
limitations: Focus on cryo-cooler applications; general applicability not explored. Pre- and post-layout simulations only; no silicon results.
primary_theme: Programmable voltage regulation for specialized applications
